Group booking for guided visits of the Château de Voltaire

Tour operators, associations, companies, senior clubs and schools: I organise guided group visits of Voltaire’s château and town in four languages, just across the border from Geneva.

Guided group visits, organised for you

Every group is different. I adapt the length, the theme and the pace of each guided visit of the Château de Voltaire to your travellers, and I help you with timings, coach arrival and admission to the monument.

Large groups are split into sub-groups with coordinated timings, so that everyone hears the stories in good conditions. Group tours are available in English, French, German and Russian.

Tour operators and coach companies

Planning a coach tour through Geneva and the Pays de Gex? Send me your itinerary: I fit the Château de Voltaire into your schedule and confirm arrival, parking and timings in advance.

Group booking questions

How far ahead should a group book?

Ideally four to six weeks ahead, especially in spring and early summer, when the château is busiest.

What is the maximum group size?

About 30 people per guide. Larger groups are split into sub-groups with coordinated timings.

Is admission to the château included?

Admission is set by the Centre des monuments nationaux and shown separately in the quote, so you always know what you pay for.

Ready to book your group?

Tell me your date, group size and language: you will receive a programme and a quote within 48 hours.
